onboarding_welcome_body: Beside You. Keep your medication schedule and records safely on this device
onboarding_feature_offline: Your medication data stays on this device
onboarding_feature_reminders: Get reminders when it is time to take medicine
onboarding_feature_stock: Track doses and remaining medication stock
onboarding_notifications_body: Allow notifications so Besyu can stay beside you and remind you when it is time to take medicine
onboarding_permission_not_enabled: Permission is not enabled. You can enable it later in system settings.
onboarding_precise_body: On Android you can optionally allow Alarms & reminders for more precise delivery. Without it the app uses battery-friendly inexact reminders.
onboarding_precise_optional: Optional. The app still works without this permission.
onboarding_ready_body: Besyu is ready to stay beside you. Add your medication and choose the times you want to be reminded
settings_theme_desc: Choose a look that feels comfortable. Changes apply immediately.
settings_language_desc: Choose English or Thai. Before you choose a language Besyu follows the device locale.
settings_profile_local: Profile data stays on this device and is optional.
settings_camera_photos_desc: Requested only when you capture or select a medication photo
settings_system_permissions_desc: Open device settings to review or change permissions
settings_about_desc: Beside You. An offline medication companion with no application server.
settings_offline_desc: Medication records and profile data stay on this device
refill_quantity_invalid: Enter a quantity greater than zero
checkin_safety_note: Record what you noticed. Besyu does not determine whether the medication caused it.
checkin_note_hint: Add context in your own words
doctor_summary_disclaimer: This is a factual summary of records you entered in Besyu. It does not diagnose conditions or determine whether a medication caused an observation.
doctor_summary_no_observations: No reported observations in this period
emergency_card_disclaimer: This card shows only information you entered and current medication records from Besyu. It does not diagnose conditions.
emergency_allergies_helper: Enter only information you know or were told.
emergency_notes_helper: Optional user-entered notes. Besyu does not infer diagnoses.
emergency_local_note: Emergency information stays on this device. Clearing it does not delete medication records.
emergency_saved: Emergency information saved on this device
emergency_clear_confirm_body: This removes the emergency profile from this device. Medication records are not deleted.
